ns2:section.sectionText: GER 420: German Cultural History Introduction to a number of key texts, figures, and issues in German-language intellectual and cultural history from the Middle Ages to the present. We will consider how figures such as Luther, Kant, Nietzsche, and Freud have had a profound effect on the world and the way we understand it and ourselves. We will also explore how other artists, writers, poets, and filmmakers approach issues including identity, justice, power, freedom, and ethics.
